comparison.objective: Align a loose pipe end and slide a repair coupling across the pipe joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pipe support, coaxial alignment, and sleeve translation versus sieve load sharing and selective flow.
comparison.success_condition: Each pipe inserted ≥30 mm into centered coupling, new pipe aligned and seated in elbow, hands released; pullout or falling permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Tests long-part alignment and coupling installation, not particle separation.
